About

Product thinking with a business lens.

I’m a product leader with 10+ years of experience across product development, business development, and growth. I’ve worked on marketplace products, neobanking, BNPL, PFM, and customer loyalty — combining product thinking with business modeling and commercial logic to build scalable solutions for both users and organizations.

How I work

Clarity before complexity.

I use data, customer insight, business modeling, and cross-functional alignment to turn broad challenges into a product direction teams can actually execute. Whenever reliable data is available, I ground decisions in evidence — structuring the problem, building models where useful, and testing assumptions before turning them into product choices.

Selected projects

Outcomes, not task lists.

Selected products where strategy, business design, and execution came together to create measurable value.

01 · DARIC
BNPL · B2B Credit Platform

Building a flexible B2B credit platform around how organizations actually fund employee benefits.

I helped shape Daric into a modular B2B BNPL platform for employee benefits — combining dedicated wallets, 1- and 4-month credit, flexible installment plans, loan credit lines, and asset-backed purchase credit. The model was designed so each organization could configure welfare and financing around its own budget, policy, and workforce needs.

From a single credit product to a configurable financing ecosystem
Product approachModular wallets, configurable credit terms, repayment options, and collateral-backed eligibility.
Business impactExpanded the proposition from a single credit use case into a broader financing platform for both employer-funded and user-backed scenarios.
02 · OMIDBANK
Neobank · Product Strategy

Expanding a neobank from transactional banking into a broader daily financial platform.

I helped define a product strategy that moved OmidBank beyond core banking into a broader financial platform. The roadmap combined PFM, a financial marketplace, savings experiences, a cashback card linked to user assets, lending capabilities, and simpler app journeys to increase utility and repeat usage.

A portfolio strategy built around frequency, financial utility, and retention
Product approachPFM, financial marketplace, savings tools, cashback-linked card, lending, and UX flow improvements.
Business impactIncreased the product’s day-to-day financial utility and supported a lending proposition that reached 4th place among neobanks in retail lending.
03 · EWYAS
CLV · Customer Economics

Turning Customer Lifetime Value into a working system for marketing and loyalty decisions.

I built a CLV-based decision system to improve marketing allocation, customer prioritization, and promotion targeting. The model was also connected to the loyalty scoring engine so rewards and marketing investment could reflect the underlying economics of each customer segment.

Customer value translated into budget, promotion, and loyalty logic
Product approachCLV segmentation, value-based promotion design, and integration with the loyalty scoring engine.
Business impactCreated a stronger basis for marketing allocation, promotion efficiency, and differentiated treatment of higher-value customers.
04 · SHEYPOOR
Marketplace · Professional Sellers

From isolated ads to a structured experience for professional sellers.

Sheypoor was primarily a classified ads platform. We created a more structured proposition for professional users, including the Alounak model for real-estate agencies: package purchase, capacity allocation across agents, and differentiated capabilities such as video listings, higher refresh limits, and regional showcase sections.

A stronger B2B proposition inside a consumer marketplace
Product approachProfessional storefront logic, shared listing capacity, and premium feature packaging.
Business impactMoved the experience beyond simple ad posting and created a clearer monetizable proposition for professional sellers.
